terra.problem: The line about cave hide-outs being crowded with names and one name getting the refuge does not make clear sense.
The comment about sharing a cave with these men suggests they are in the cave with David. The psalm does not say that.
Papa Dorin says his feet would vote to run, adding feet to his character. His gold base is part of him.
The joke makes David's poetic way of addressing his instruments the setup for the punchline. The way Scripture is written is never the joke.
